what_happened: The job "Rewrite agent prompts leaner and rebase the prompt token budgets" (prompts) was rejected. The verifier marked 1 of 8 acceptance criteria unmet. That criterion says the diff must drop text that restates defaults, catalog or facts already in the brief, and keep each role's job, output contract and hard rules. The verifier gave one major finding: the verifier's cited-document rule was dropped from crates/athena-context/prompts/verifier.md and not moved anywhere else. No check failed. The trim cut a rule, not just repetition.
cause: Prompt trimming is judged by reading alone. Nothing separates text that restates the brief from text that carries a rule only that prompt holds. The producer is not given a list of each prompt's hard rules to keep, and no check compares the old and new rules, or confirms a removed rule exists elsewhere, before the final verifier. The same weakness caused the earlier trim rejections: a rule is lost, and only the last verdict catches it.
prevention: Add a code check that runs before verification on any job editing files under crates/athena-context/prompts/. It extracts the rule statements (bullets and must/never lines) from the old and new version of each prompt. It then requires every removed rule to appear in another always-loaded file, the brief or the defaults, or to be listed in the decision entry with the place it now lives. The producer is shown the same list of rules per prompt up front, so it trims only wording that restates the brief.
proposed_request: Retry of job 20261109-035221-jj8g: rewrite the agent prompts under crates/athena-context/prompts/ and the capability prompts leaner, and rebase the prompt token budgets. Outcome: each prompt drops text that restates defaults, catalog or facts already in the brief, and keeps each role's job, output contract and every hard rule. Restore the verifier's cited-document rule in verifier.md, or move it to a named place that every verifier run loads. Before editing, list each prompt's hard rules. Afterward, show for every removed rule where it now lives. Acceptance: (1) the diff shows no hard rule removed without a stated new home; (2) the verifier's cited-document rule is present in verifier.md or a named always-loaded file; (3) the prompt budgets tests pass with rebased budgets; (4) cargo test, clippy and fmt pass; (5) CHANGELOG.md has an entry; (6) docs/decisions.md has an entry that lists each removed passage with its file and reason, and claims nothing beyond the diff.
